name: Sundarbans National Park
shortDescription: The world's largest contiguous mangrove forest and sanctuary of the Royal Bengal Tiger.
description: Spanning over 10,000 square kilometers across the Ganges Delta, the Sundarbans is a UNESCO World Heritage site. Navigate serene mudflat waterways by wooden launch, observe estuarine crocodiles, spotted deer, and bird species, and experience one of Earth's most mystical tidal ecosystems.
bestTimeToVisit: October to March (Cooler weather & optimal wildlife spotting)
gettingThere: Accessible via vessel from Mongla Port or Khulna City (approx. 3-hour river cruise to reserve entry).

name: Cox's Bazar Sea Beach
shortDescription: The world's longest unbroken natural sandy sea beach stretching 120 kilometers.
description: Experience golden sunsets, rolling Bay of Bengal surf, vibrant seafood markets, and scenic coastal drives along the Marine Drive connecting Cox's Bazar to Teknaf.
bestTimeToVisit: November to February (Mild weather & clear coastal waters)
gettingThere: Direct flights available from Dhaka (DAC) to Cox's Bazar Airport (CXB), or express bus via Dhaka-Chittagong highway.

name: Sreemangal Tea Country
shortDescription: The Tea Capital of Bangladesh, renowned for rolling emerald hills and Lawachara Rainforest.
description: Wander through endless terraced tea estates, sample the famous Seven-Layer Tea at Nilkantha Tea Cabin, and trek through Lawachara National Park to catch glimpses of endangered Western Hoolock Gibbons.
bestTimeToVisit: June to September (Monsoon lushness) or October to March (Comfortable trekking)
gettingThere: Scenic 4-hour train ride on the Parabat Express from Dhaka Komlapur station to Sreemangal.

name: Ratargul Freshwater Swamp
shortDescription: Bangladesh's only freshwater swamp forest, submerged in translucent emerald waters.
description: Glide through calm green waters in wooden dinghy canoes amidst submerged Millettia pinnata trees. The canopy forms an enchanted green tunnel teeming with kingfishers, snakes, and freshwater fish.
bestTimeToVisit: July to October (Monsoon season when the forest is fully inundated)
gettingThere: Located 26km from Sylhet city. Accessible by local CNG auto-rickshaw followed by boat ride at Gowainghat.

name: Saint Martin's Coral Island
shortDescription: The tropical coral island of Bangladesh with crystal turquoise waters and coconut groves.
description: Located 9km south of Teknaf, Narikel Jinjira (Saint Martin's) offers pristine turquoise sea, coral reefs, fresh grilled lobster, and starry night skies far from city pollution.
bestTimeToVisit: November to March (Ferry service operates exclusively during winter)
gettingThere: Take an official sea cruise ship (Keari Sindbad/Bay One) from Teknaf jetty (2.5 hours cruise).

name: Sajek Valley
shortDescription: The Queen of Hills where clouds dance right outside your wooden cottage balcony.
description: Perched 2,000 feet above sea level in the Chittagong Hill Tracts, Sajek Valley offers breathtaking mist-covered mountain valleys, Indigenous Tripura and Lushai culture, and sunrise views above a sea of clouds.
bestTimeToVisit: September to February (Clear mountain vistas & dramatic cloud oceans)
gettingThere: Travel from Khagrachhari via army-escorted Chander Gari (4WD Jeep) along winding mountain roads.

name: Somapura Mahavihara at Paharpur
shortDescription: One of the most important 8th-century Buddhist monastic complexes in the Indian subcontinent.
description: Constructed during the Pala Empire, Somapura Mahavihara features a central cruciform temple surrounded by 177 monastic cells. The terracotta plaques along its base depict ancient Bengali life, fauna, and folklore.
gettingThere: Located in Naogaon district, accessible by train or car from Rajshahi or Bogura city.

name: Kaptai Lake & Rangamati
shortDescription: South Asia's largest man-made lake surrounded by lush green hills and tribal settlements.
description: Cruise through serene emerald waters past Shuvolong Waterfalls, visit Chakma royal palaces, and shop for hand-woven textiles at the floating tribal markets.
gettingThere: 77km east of Chittagong city via highway bus or private car.
